## Purpose and Scopesvg image

The `updatecontext` command generates patch files by comparing two Markdown context files and computing their unified diff. This command enables version control and incremental update workflows by creating portable patch files that capture the differences between two project states.

For applying generated patches, see [updater](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.2-updater). For high-performance rsync-based patch generation (recommended for large projects), see [smartupdate](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.3-smartupdate). For HTML context patches, see [updatecontexthtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.3.4-updatecontexthtml).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L27) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py43](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L43-L43)

---

## Command Syntaxsvg image

### Argumentssvg image

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `old_context.md` | Input File | Original/baseline Markdown context file |
| `new_context.md` | Input File | Modified/updated Markdown context file |
| `output_patch.md` | Output File | Generated patch file containing unified diffs |

### Invocationsvg image

The command is registered as a console script entry point in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py43](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L43-L43):

```px-2
'updatecontext=update_context:main'
```

This maps the CLI command to the `main()` function in the `update_context.py` module.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py39-54](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L39-L54) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L27)

## Technical Implementationsvg image

### Parsing Phasesvg image

The `updatecontext` command relies on `parse_md_constructor()` from `contexter_utils.py` to convert both input Markdown context files into Python dictionaries:

**Parser Pattern Recognition:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py70-108](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L70-L108)

- **Header Pattern:** `^--- (FILE|SKIPPED \(BINARY\)): (.*) ---$` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py76](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L76-L76)
- **Code Fence Detection:** Lines starting with ```````` mark code block boundaries [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py95-96](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L95-L96)
- **Binary Files:** Stored as `None` values in the dictionary [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py90-92](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L90-L92)
- **Text Files:** Stored as complete content strings [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py99](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L99-L99)

**Data Structure Output:**

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py70-108](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L70-L108)

### Diff Generation Phasesvg image

The command compares the two parsed dictionaries file-by-file:

**Comparison Logic:**

1. **Identify Changed Files:** Compare content strings for files present in both versions
2. **Identify New Files:** Files in `new_context` but not in `old_context`
3. **Identify Deleted Files:** Files in `old_context` but not in `new_context`
4. **Skip Binary Files:** Files with `None` values are not diffed

**Diff Format:** Standard unified diff format using the `patch` library [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py11](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L11-L11)

- Includes context lines (typically 3 lines before/after changes)
- Uses `+` for additions, `-` for deletions
- Contains line number information in chunk headers

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py11](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L11-L11) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml28](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L28-L28)

### Output Formatsvg image

The generated patch file follows this Markdown structure:

@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
context line
context line
-old content
+new content
context line

```px-2
--- DIFF FOR: path/to/file2.js ---
```

@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+new line at start
existing line
existing line

Each file's diff is wrapped in:

1. **Header Line:** `--- DIFF FOR: <filepath> ---` marking the file being patched
2. **Code Fence:** Triple backticks enclosing the unified diff
3. **Unified Diff Content:** Standard diff format output

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L161)

## Comparison with Other Update Commandssvg image

### updatecontext vs smartupdate vs updatersvg image

| Aspect | updatecontext | smartupdate | updater |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Purpose** | Generate patches | Generate patches | Apply patches |
| **Algorithm** | Unified diff | rsync delta-encoding | Patch application |
| **Input** | Two `.md` contexts | Two `.md` contexts or directories | Context + patch |
| **Output** | Patch file | Patch file | Updated context |
| **Performance** | Standard | **High (Recommended)** [svg imageREADME.md29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L29-L29) | N/A |
| **Use Case** | General diffing | Large projects, many changes | Receiving changes |
| **Module** | `update_context.py` | `smart_update.py` | `updater.py` |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md27-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L27-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py43-45](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L43-L45)

### When to Use updatecontextsvg image

**Appropriate Scenarios:**

- **Small to medium projects:** File count < 100, total size < 10MB
- **Simple diff requirements:** Standard unified diff format sufficient
- **Maximum compatibility:** Works with any text-based diff/patch tooling
- **Human readability:** Unified diff format is widely understood

**Consider smartupdate Instead:**

- Large projects with many files
- Binary-heavy projects (rsync handles binaries better)
- Performance-critical workflows
- Frequent incremental updates

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L29-L29)

### File-Level Organizationsvg image

### Parsing by updater Commandsvg image

The generated patch files are consumed by the `updater` command using `parse_patch_file()`:

**Parser Entry Point:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-137](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L137)

- Auto-detects format (MD vs HTML) by file extension
- Delegates to `_parse_md_patch()` for Markdown patches [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L161)
- Returns dictionary mapping file paths to `PatchSet` objects

**Markdown Patch Parser:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py139-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L139-L161)

- Pattern: `^--- DIFF FOR: (.*) ---$` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py144](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L144-L144)
- Extracts diff content between code fences
- Converts diff text to `patch.PatchSet` objects using `patch.fromstring()` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py150-159](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L150-L159)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py131-161](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L131-L161)

## Error Handling and Edge Casessvg image

### Common Scenariossvg image

| Scenario | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| **Identical Files** | No diff section generated for unchanged files |
| **Binary Files** | Binary files (marked as `None`) are skipped in diff |
| **New Files** | Entire file content shown as additions |
| **Deleted Files** | Entire file content shown as deletions |
| **Missing Input File** | `parse_md_constructor()` returns `None` [svg imagecontexter\_utils.py107](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L107-L107) |
| **Invalid Context Format** | Parser may return incomplete dictionary or `None` |

### File Type Detectionsvg image

The parser distinguishes between text and binary files:

- **Binary Marker:** `SKIPPED (BINARY)` in header [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py76](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L76-L76)
- **Dictionary Value:** Binary files stored as `None` [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py91](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L91-L91)
- **Diff Skip:** Binary files excluded from diff generation

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py70-108](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L70-L108)

---

## Performance Characteristicssvg image

### Time Complexitysvg image

- **Parsing:** O(n) where n = total lines in both context files
- **Comparison:** O(m × k) where m = number of files, k = average file size
- **Diff Generation:** O(k) per file using standard diff algorithms
- **Overall:** Approximately O(total\_content\_size)

### Memory Usagesvg image

- **Peak Memory:** Two complete file dictionaries in memory simultaneously
- **Scales With:** Total size of both context files combined
- **Optimization:** Consider `smartupdate` for large projects (uses streaming/chunked processing)

### Practical Limitssvg image

**Recommended Usage Bounds:**

- Files per context: < 500
- Total context size: < 50MB
- Average file size: < 500KB

**Beyond These Limits:** Use `smartupdate` command which implements rsync-based delta encoding for better performance [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L29-L29)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L29-L29)

---
